|translation='''Title:''' CZ-3 (Seezee-Three).

'''Card text:''' When your opponent declares a battle or Force drain at CZ-3's location or an adjacent site, you may deploy cards to that location as a react. Pay the normal deployment costs.

'''Lore:''' A CZ communications droid manufactured by Serv-O-Droid. An older model that remains widely used. It has a built-in comlink and sophisticated scrambling and encryption capabilities.
